# Stable or Gone

Stable or Gone is a source-backed historical registry for stablecoins.

Site: https://sog.badjoke-lab.com/

## Purpose

The site documents stablecoin lifecycle status, issuer and organization relationships, depegs, recoveries, regulatory actions, reserve disclosures, redemption access, migrations, wind-downs, collapses, and unresolved public-information gaps.

It is historical reference material, not live market data, legal advice, tax advice, investment advice, wallet support, issuer support, or redemption support.

## Important public pages

- Home: https://sog.badjoke-lab.com/

## Canonical record URL patterns

- Stablecoin record: /stablecoin/{slug}/
- Organization compatibility record: /issuer/{slug}/
- Event record: /event/{id}/

These URL patterns should be treated as stable public references.

## Registry v2 field model

The public registry separates:

- stablecoin entity
- organization entity
- stablecoin-organization relationship
- stablecoin event
- evidence
- evidence relation
- reserve report
- known unknown
- deployment

Stablecoin records may include lifecycle status, issuance status, peg reference, backing types, stabilization mechanism, governance model, reserve profile, redemption profile, organization relationships, event timeline, deployments, open questions, and source tables.

Event records may include subject stablecoins, subject organizations, event detail kind, depeg detail, regulatory detail, reserve-change detail, redemption-change detail, migration detail, and scoped sources.

Evidence records are scoped to the stablecoin, organization, event, and claim they support. A source should not be treated as proof of every field on a page.

## Source and reliability policy

Stable or Gone prefers primary public sources where available, including issuer statements, official notices, reserve reports, regulatory documents, protocol documentation, developer documentation, and archived pages.

Secondary sources and research papers may be used for context, but high-impact claims should be supported by primary or official sources when possible.

## Corrections

Source-backed corrections, missing records, broken links, and public evidence can be submitted through:

- https://sog.badjoke-lab.com/contact/
- https://github.com/badjoke-lab/stable-or-gone/issues

Do not submit private keys, seed phrases, passwords, wallet credentials, exchange account details, identity documents, bank information, or sensitive personal information.
